newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle $112/dressed, up $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle $112/dressed, up $1 - USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers turned active at midmorning, USDA said.
Live sales fully $0.50 per cwt higher; dressed basis mostly $1.00 higher. Demand uniformly strong. Seller interest firm at top side of quotes.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights)
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1300 lbs - live basis 69.00; dressed basis 111.00-112.00, some "calf feds" early 110.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1200 lbs - live basis 69.00; dressed basis 111.00-112.00, some "calf feds" early to 110.00.
